question: According to the Economic Survey 2023-24, what percentage of India's population is expected to reside in urban areas by 2030?
solution:
The correct answer is __**0.4**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• According to the Economic Survey 2023-24, **40% of India's population is projected to live in urban areas by 2030**.
 
• This projection indicates a significant rise in urbanization, driven by **economic growth and migration trends**.
 
• Urbanization is expected to have a direct impact on infrastructure, housing, transportation, and public services.
 
• The survey highlights the need for sustainable urban planning and development to accommodate the growing urban population.
 
• India's ongoing urbanization aligns with global trends, where developing countries experience rapid urban growth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Urbanization in India**

 
 
• Urbanization refers to the process by which more people live and work in cities and urban areas than in rural areas.
 
• In India, urbanization is driven by factors like industrialization, better employment opportunities, and improved living standards.
 
• As of the 2011 Census, approximately 31% of India’s population lived in urban areas.
 
 
 
• **Smart Cities Mission**
 
 
• Launched by the Government of India in 2015, the Smart Cities Mission aims to develop urban areas with advanced infrastructure and technology-driven solutions.
 
• The mission focuses on improving the quality of life through better housing, transportation, water supply, and waste management.
 
 
 
• **Challenges of Urbanization**
 
 
• Urbanization in India faces challenges such as overcrowding, inadequate infrastructure, traffic congestion, and pollution.
 
• Affordable housing and slum redevelopment are critical areas that require attention.
 
 
 
• **UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**
 
 
• Goal 11 of the UN SDGs aims to make cities inclusive, safe, resilient, and sustainable.
 
• Urbanization in India contributes to achieving these global objectives through better urban planning and development initiatives.
